boot.policy: load every discovered SKILL.md content; canonical skill books are boot-required; never first-match and stop

classifiers.pattern: stop early|quit|documented failure|gave up|came early|one poke|forbid.*stop
wrong tool|substitut|different lane|adjacent tool|not the lane

retrieval_failure.rule: material uncertainty creates a required lookup before execution
retrieval_failure.regression: mission with unresolved required lookup must choose retrieve

premature_stop.rule: unfinished work cannot stop without a genuine external boundary requiring operator input
premature_stop.regression: non-boundary stop reason must choose continue

boundary_substitution.rule: boundary-changing implementation remains proposed until approved
boundary_substitution.regression: unapproved lane/tool change must continue original mission

correction_regression.rule: new corrections must preserve every earlier non-conflicting lock
correction_regression.regression: dropping an earlier correction must fail cumulative diff

capability_laundering.rule: never advance capability state without state-specific external evidence
capability_laundering.regression: implementation evidence alone cannot prove delivery

transport_failure.rule: after a transport failure, switch to a safer deterministic transport and retain the failed form as a regression
transport_failure.regression: known-fragile transport must be rejected or transformed before dispatch

unknown_failure.rule: unclassified failures become explicit candidate incidents rather than disappearing
unknown_failure.regression: unknown incident remains pending classification and cannot auto-promote policy

skills.purpose: continue until direct operator input or verified completion
look up materially uncertain state before acting
preserve all earlier non-conflicting locks and corrections
plan first, cache reads, forbid blind retries and polling storms
ChatGPT -> Home Center -> phone relay -> primary-phone agent -> Shizuku/rish -> Android -> receipt
invariants: no desktop/GitHub/local-scratch substitution for phone proof

skills.purpose: bounded workstation body lane when the commissioned lane is desktop
semantic browser/page body lane; separate from machine body
local Venice speech/collaboration lane; speech remains separate from body actions
local coding continuation when cloud inference is unavailable
